name: Shadow Hunter Knife
summary: The Shadow Hunter Knife is a Witherbark troll blade sought by Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe. It is tied to the rites of the tribe’s shadow hunters.

sections.title: A Troll's Blade
sections.body: Apprentice Kryten seeks the Shadow Hunter Knife at Refuge Pointe for Archmage Malin’s research. He says the strongest Witherbark shadow hunters receive the special blade after completing their rites of passage. Their village lies southeast of Arathi, and Kryten cannot tell which hunter carries one until the struggle is done.

faq.q: Who wants the Shadow Hunter Knife?
faq.answer: Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe seeks the Shadow Hunter Knife for Archmage Malin’s research.

faq.q: Who carries the Shadow Hunter Knife?
faq.answer: The strongest Witherbark shadow hunters may carry the special knife given after their rites of passage.
Kryten says the Witherbark give the knife to their strongest shadow hunters after they complete their rites of passage.
The Witherbark live southeast of Arathi, near Witherbark Village.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, Kryten’s work at Refuge Pointe serves Archmage Malin’s research in Arathi.
